findings: scheduleEndTransition() does not navigate to NODEBREAK.html — confirmed. The function flashes red, hides intro elements, then reveals the in-page #sandboxTerminal div instead of executing window.location.href = 'NODEBREAK.html'. The FEAT-001 acceptance criterion 'After VAEL's final line the screen fades to black and navigates to NODEBREAK.html' is not met. Fix: inside the inner setTimeout (after flash.style.opacity = 0), add window.location.href = 'NODEBREAK.html' and remove or gate the in-page terminal reveal behind a feature flag if it is intentionally replacing the navigation.
